notes: This branch (PR #25) was opened days ago and never merged - it sat 13 commits behind main while Blade Runner dice, the Rules Keeper, admin accounts, and the 3D dice/cockpit surround all landed on main in the meantime. Rebased it onto current main just now, resolving conflicts in server/index.js (upload file filter now allows image/audio/PDF together; the Rules Keeper and ambient-music socket handlers are independent blocks, both kept), server/roomStore.js (blankRulesKeeper and blankMusic both defined, both backfilled on load), client/src/components/GMPanel.jsx (rulebook upload and music upload are separate sections with separate state, both kept), and client/src/components/GameScreen.jsx (MusicBar and the Instructions button both sit in the top bar now). Force-pushed the rebased branch. The feature itself is unchanged from the original: GM sets a track (URL or upload) from GM Tools, play/stop control lives in a small bar in the top bar visible to everyone, playback position is derived from a server timestamp so anyone joining or reconnecting mid-track lands in the right spot, and volume/mute are local per-person (localStorage) and never affect anyone else. To test: as GM, go to GM Tools > Ambient Music, set a track by URL or file upload, confirm the top-bar music bar shows it for both the GM and another player, press Play as GM and confirm the other player's music bar reflects playing state too (and that only the GM gets Play/Stop controls), adjust volume/mute as the non-GM player and confirm it doesn't affect the GM's own playback. Also re-ran the admin-accounts, 3D-dice, and cockpit-surround regression suites against this rebased branch - all still pass, so nothing from those merged features regressed.
